sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 12.09.2023 in connection with Crime No.460/2023, registered at Police Station Bahri District Sidhi for the offence punishable under Sections 363,366-A,376, 376(2), 376(2)(N) of the IPC and Sections 3/4, 5(L) and 6 of the POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 12.09.2023.
Material prosecution witnesses have been examined.
Prosecutrix has also been examined and she has turned hostile.
Prosecutrix was consenting party.
Applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that trial of the case will take considerable time.

In these circumstances,
applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.
It is submitted that applicant has forcefully committed rape on the prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix was minor and she was not consenting party.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.

Considering the fact that applicant is in jail since 12.09.2023 and there is no likelihood of completion of trial in near future and the fact that material witnesses have been examined in the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of R s . 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

7 . In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C..
